{{Top|leg}}
'''Energy converters''' adjusted the flow of energy. The [[cybernetic nexus ring]] contained an energy converter that adjusted the energy flowing from the ring to a connected [[Cybernetics/Legends|cybernetic]] prosthetic in order to boost performance.
